title: fix(formula): label() over a multi-select reads each selected option's label, joined
body:
Fixes #34339

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #34444 (`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, the `label(record.f)` row; the multi-select join is taught in content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx in this PR)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:公式 `label(record.X)` 作用在多选字段(`multiple: true` 的 select)上,不再出错读成 null,而是按读者语言输出每个已选项的标签,按记录里存储的顺序,用 `, ` 连接;空选择仍读 `''`,单选不变。
- **为什么改**:下游 CRM 报价行用多选字段 + `label()` 拼一句「无法估算毛利的原因」,在 18.5.0 上每条记录都读成 null,而 `os validate` / `os lint --strict` 都放行。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低。只有原先读成 null 的公式变成有文字;单选、空值、未知值的读法不变。和邮件模板 `option` 占位符走同一个拼接函数,两边不会再分叉。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts` 的 `labelEachOption` 与 `optionLabelOf` / `oneOptionLabel`;`packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts` 的 `option` 格式化器那一行;`packages/objectql/src/engine-formula-option-label.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run src/option-label.test.ts`,预期 18 个用例全绿(在 main 上其中 7 个红)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`label(record.FIELD)` over a `multiple: true` select used to throw (`renders ONE option value, and FIELD holds a list of values`), so the formula field read null on every non-empty selection. It now reads:

| Value | Reads |
|---|---|
| `['no_sales_price', 'no_customer']` | `无销售价, 无客户` (zh-CN) / `No sales price, No customer` (en-US) |
| `['no_freight_region']` | that one label |
| `[]`, `null` | `''` (unchanged; measured below) |
| a listed value no option declares | as stored, as the single-value path reads an unknown value |
| a list holding an object | runtime fault, as an object value faults today |

- **One rule, one helper.** `labelEachOption` (`packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts`, package-internal) maps each listed value through the caller's single-value lookup and joins with `, `. The mail template's `option` hole (`template-engine.ts`, `OPTION_ARGUMENT_RULE`) now calls the same helper instead of its own `map(...).join(', ')`, so the two cannot drift. A unit test asserts `label()` and `formatValue('option', …)` print the same string for the same list.
- **Order: stored order.** Measured: `['no_freight_region', 'no_sales_price']` reads `No freight region, No sales price`, although the options declare `no_sales_price` first. That is the order the template engine already used. This is the claim's choice (claim 6923097287, Shape: "by the same rule the mail-template option hole already uses"), and it differs from the card's words: ask 1 says "joined with `, ` in option order" while naming the mail-template `option` hole (`OPTION_ARGUMENT_RULE`) as precedent, and that hole measures STORED order. So a reader of the downstream CRM quote line gets the labels in the order the values were stored, not the order the options are declared.
- **No `labels()` sibling, and no author-time refusal** (the card's ask 2): the card asks for it only "Until (1) ships", and ask 1 ships here; claim 6923097287 (Shape) records that choice. Ruling 6919059607 is the claim permission (batch 1), not a ruling on order or on ask 2.
- **The objectql seam needed no change.** `formula-option-labels.ts` builds the label map from every served field that declares `options`, whatever `multiple` says, with the translation bundle laid over it. The real-engine pin below reads translated multi-select labels through it unchanged.
- **Docs:** `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` said "A multi-value select is refused." It now teaches the join, the order and the empty reading.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/option-label.test.ts`: a new describe for the multi-select (zh-CN and en-US join, one element, stored order, empty list and null, unknown value, composition, a field without options, an object inside the list, and agreement with the mail `option` hole). The old "refuses a list value" assertion is removed. An object value is still refused, in its own case.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-formula-option-label.test.ts`: a new top-level describe on the real `ObjectQL` engine (stub driver, i18n service with a zh-CN bundle) reads `label(record.gaps)` over a multi-select in zh-CN and en-US, beside a single-select CONTROL on the same record, plus the one-element and empty cases.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/formula-option-label-locale.dogfood.test.ts`: the fixture gains a multi-select and its formula. One new case reads it through REST (`POST` / `GET /data/:object/:id` with `Accept-Language`) in zh-CN and en-US, with the existing single-select name as the CONTROL, plus the one-element, empty-list and unset cases.

## Acceptance notes

- `main` is red on `check:platform-checklist` (`approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` VARIANTS STALE). That red is main's, not this diff's; the seat has a stopgap PR. `Lint & Repo Gates` will show it on this PR.
- A CEL read of a key the record does not carry (`record.gaps` on `{}`) faults with `No such key` before `label()` runs. This is the same for a single select and is not changed here. The engine hands formulas every declared field, so a stored record does not hit it.
